item.title: Farina’s comeback secures Lady Demon tennis win
item.description: The Northwestern State Lady Demons opened their home schedule Thursday with a gritty 5–2 victory over Jackson State at the Jack Fisher Tennis Complex, highlighted by a pivotal comeback performance from Maria Farina that helped secure the team’s second win of the season. “It was a very tough match,” head coach Marcos Morelli said. “Jackson … Continue reading Farina’s comeback secures Lady Demon tennis win

item.title: Times when you don’t take a bus ride for granted
item.description: This winter blast has created thousands of hassles, headaches, backaches and even some scary or dangerous situations here and right over there. item.title: Stifling defense, clutch late plays lift Lady Demons over Nicholls
item.description: In a matchup of two of the best defenses in the Southland Conference, once again it was the Northwestern State women’s basketball team that stood the tallest. item.title: NCHS, St. Mary’s playoff teams from Fall 2025 celebrated at LSHOF museum
item.description: Over 200 people attended Thursday night as student-athletes, coaches and staff from fall sports Louisiana High School Athletic Association playoff teams at Natchitoches Central and St. Mary’s were honored by the Louisiana Sports Hall of Fame Foundation and FLASH, the local support group for the LSHOF and Northwest Louisiana History Museum at 800 Front Street … Continue reading NCHS, St. Mary’s playoff teams from Fall 2025 celebrated at LSHOF museum

item.title: Reading on the River returns to the Natchitoches riverbank on March 14
item.description: The Service League of Natchitoches will host Reading on the River, an annual community literacy event promoting the importance and enjoyment of reading outside of the classroom, on Saturday, March 14, 2026. The event will take place on the Natchitoches Riverbank from 10am-2pm. The free, fun event for pre-K to 5th grade children includes reading-related … Continue reading Reading on the River returns to the Natchitoches riverbank on March 14

item.title: Marthaville Elementary/Jr. High School holds 5th grade D.A.R.E. graduation
item.description: Marthaville Elementary/Jr. High School recently held its 5th Grade D.A.R.E. Graduation, recognizing students who completed the Drug Abuse Resistance Education program.

item.title: PUBLIC NOTICE: Jury duty cancelled for Monday
item.description: For all Natchitoches Parish Citizens that received a Jury Summons for Monday Feb. 2, 2026, all business in front of the 10 Judicial District Court’s jury term has been completed and this jury has been cancelled. Thanks for your willingness to serve. David StameyClerk of Court Natchitoches Parish318-352-8152

item.title: NCIF Treasurer Resigns, Citing Governance and Transparency Concerns
item.description: By Staff Report Former board member and treasurer Marvin Blake Jr. has formally resigned from the Natchitoches Community Improvement Foundation (NCIF), citing concerns over governance practices, financial oversight, and compliance with the organization’s bylaws. The resignation, dated January 29, 2026, was submitted to legal counsel involved in ongoing court proceedings related to the foundation. Blake … Continue reading NCIF Treasurer Resigns, Citing Governance and Transparency Concerns

item.title: Natchitoches Parish Sheriff’s Office receives clean audit
item.description: The Natchitoches Parish Sheriff’s Office (NPSO) has received a clean audit following an independent review of its 2025 financial operations conducted by the certified public accounting firm Thomas, Cunningham, Broadway and Todtenbier.
